access_model: Paid, edition- and license-dependent Salesforce org access; Sales Cloud advertises a 30-day trial, while Developer Edition is free for testing and development. REST API access is enabled by default in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and Developer Edition orgs; Professional Edition requires API access as an add-on. API use also requires an org, a user with API Enabled permission, and an External Client App or existing Connected App configured for OAuth.
api_breadth: Documented Salesforce REST resources cover sObject records and relationships, queries/search, metadata and describe information, composite operations, limits, actions, approvals, files/content, platform events, and other platform resources; the API is subject to edition/license-based daily allocations and other limits.
mcp_status: Salesforce documents Hosted MCP Servers as available for MCP-compatible clients. Standard servers are disabled by default and must be enabled by an administrator; they enforce per-user authentication and Salesforce security rules. Available documented surfaces include SObject CRUD/query/search, CMS content, Data 360, Tableau Next, CRM Analytics, metadata grounding, and other product-specific servers. Hosted MCP usage is intended for customers with Flex Credits and may be billed; setup requires an administrator or equivalent to create an External Client App and configure OAuth/security settings.
blockers: A Salesforce org and a user with API Enabled permission are required for REST API calls.
Professional Edition requires API access as an add-on; API access is not included in every edition.

A client must be authorized through an External Client App or existing Connected App using OAuth 2.0; creation of new Connected Apps is restricted as of Spring '26 and Salesforce says to contact Support if continued Connected App creation is required.

API calls are governed by aggregate org-level daily allocations based on edition and license type; Developer Edition is documented at 15,000 calls per 24 hours, while Enterprise/Professional-with-API-access and Unlimited/Performance have license-based formulas.
Hosted MCP standard servers are disabled by default, require administrator setup and per-user OAuth/PKCE, and are intended only for customers with Flex Credits, with possible usage billing.
